officialRulebookTextOccurrences.sourceText: Until the Hibernatorium is discovered, the Robot cannot be Activated.
Shuffle all 6 Robot cards, draw 1 without looking, place it face down on the Robot slot, and leave the rest unseen in the box.
Place 1 full Ammo token and 1 Oxygen token on the slots next to the Robot card.
Assemble the Robot model and place it on the Hibernatorium.
Activate the Robot is a 1-Action-card Basic Action carrying the Not In Combat restriction.
A chosen effect must be entirely resolvable; cards may provide more than one effect to choose from.
An effect with no clearly specified target is local to the Room of the Character performing it.
Components are finite; where no special exhaustion rule exists, unavailable component use does nothing.
The affected Character chooses which Serious Wound to discard and a player may restore fewer Health points than stated.
A malfunctioned Robot cannot be used and has no text/icons; effects only requiring a Robot remain available; repeated Robot Malfunction placement is ignored.
Discard-Malfunction effects may remove a marker from the Character's Room or an Item/Robot there unless stated otherwise.
A Room holds at most 3 Secure tokens and cannot be Secured while it contains an Intruder.
If Malfunction supply is empty, place Fire in the Room if possible; if required Fire cannot be placed because Fire supply is empty, destroy the Facility.
One randomly selected face-down Robot starts in the Hibernatorium and acts only when assigned Actions by Characters.
Reveal the Robot card when any Room is connected to the Hibernatorium for the first time; the Robot can then be Activated.
Intruders completely ignore the Robot in all cases.
There are 6 different Robot cards and only 1 appears in a game; each has a unique effect.
Activate locally by discarding 1 Action card while in the Room with the Robot.
Activate remotely from a Computer Room by discarding 1 additional Action card.
A Character with a Data token may Activate remotely without the additional card.
A Robot with Malfunction has no Action and all game effects mentioning it are unavailable; its Tactical Gear remains usable and an adjacent Character may remove the marker.
Robot movement occurs only from player Actions, one neighboring Room at a time; it ignores Intruders but not Closed Doors.
The Robot cannot normally traverse an Unexplored Corridor and never makes a Noise roll.
Exploration Robot is the only exception: it may Explore a new Room and could make a Noise roll.
The Robot has its own Tactical Gear slots and starts with 1 Ammo and 1 Oxygen token.
A co-located Character using Tactical Gear may use Robot tokens and move tokens between Character and Robot slots.
The player allocates Burst-die Hits among Intruders under type limits, loses leftovers, then resolves any additional-effects symbol; 4 and additional effects share one die face.

baseApplicable.printedText:
Q: Drilling Station – If the robot is broken, can the Drilling Station be used to create a corridor?
A: No it cannot.

excludedExpansion.printedText:
Q. Rise of the Machine Event – Can it Malfunction an undiscovered Hibernatorium?
A: Yes.

Q. If the Robot is malfunctioned, are events regarding the robot (like “Part of the Cult”) still resolved?
A: Yes.
